name: Sister Mermaid
source:
Main character is suddenly told to transfer to girls school without explaining reason. He becomes swimming club adviser even though club captain hates him. How will his new life fare?

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/06/vn-of-month-october-2003-lovers-koi-ni.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主人公突然被告知要转入一所女子学校，却没有得到任何理由。尽管游泳社社长讨厌他，他还是成了社团顾问。他的新生活将会如何？

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/06/vn-of-month-october-2003-lovers-koi-ni.html]vndbreview[/url]]
